crossRefs.note: Therefore Yahweh, the God of Armies says, “Because you speak this word, behold, I will make my words in your mouth…
If I say, I will not make mention of him, or speak any more in his name, then there is in my heart as it were a burning…
They said to one another, “Weren’t our hearts burning within us, while he spoke to us along the way, and while he…
It is the spirit who gives life. The flesh profits nothing. The words that I speak to you are spirit, and are life.
Tongues like fire appeared and were distributed to them, and one sat on each of them.
Now when they heard this, they were cut to the heart, and said to Peter and the rest of the apostles, “Brothers, what…
to the one a stench from death to death, to the other a sweet aroma from life to life. Who is sufficient for these…
for the weapons of our warfare are not of the flesh, but mighty before God to the throwing down of strongholds,
throwing down imaginations and every high thing that is exalted against the knowledge of God and bringing every thought…
For the word of God is living and active, and sharper than any two-edged sword, piercing even to the dividing of soul…
If anyone desires to harm them, fire proceeds out of their mouth and devours their enemies. If anyone desires to harm…

translations.web: “Isn’t my word like fire?” says Yahweh; “and like a hammer that breaks the rock in pieces?
translations.bsb: “Is not My word like fire,” declares the LORD, “and like a hammer that smashes a rock?”
translations.kjv: Is not my word like as a fire? saith the LORD; and like a hammer that breaketh the rock in pieces?
translations.asv: Is not my word like fire? saith Jehovah; and like a hammer that breaketh the rock in pieces?
